title: How to change font sizes in all Thunderbird windows? UNIQUE!
creator: redacted
content:
Prelude: Monitor specs matter: Samsung Odyssey G93SC [Monitor] 1194.7 × 365 × 180.8 mm (approx. 47 × 14.4 × 7.1 inches) on a NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 [Display adapter] Display is 5120 x 1440 (recommended) Scale = 100% ISSUE: Fonts in Thunderbird size varies from readable to very hard to read.

Screencap below with filename [font-size-R4--181158.jpg] on your device at 100%, I hope, will show what I see.

Some Fonts in different Thunderbird 'panes' are unreadable without zooming in. The {body} of a reply is very small (see font-size-body--Rev3-07-19-2026_01.jpg below) The image will show the cursor at top left of Body.

I did search here but nothing of this nature it. So here is my question:

QUESTION: Is there a way to edit a config file or the likes to set fonts to be responsive (like a web site is same in any size screen and compensates for size?

Thanks for the read,

~r

creator: mselvi
content:
Iyi günler,

müsterimin mail adresini hostinger'dan Microsoft 365'e geçirdik, maili kurmadan önce thunderbird ile komple yedek aldim, 20 küsür GB bir dosya olusturdu, yeni ayarlarla mail'i kurdugumda bazi dosyalar kayboldu dogal olarak, sonrasinda yedekten dosyalari almak istedigimde yedek dosyasinda hata oldugunu manuel olarak restoration islemini yapman gerektigini söyledi, manuel olarak zip dosyasini winrar ile açmak istedigimde imap dosyasinda hata oldugunu belirtiyor. Basina böyle bir sorun gelen var mi?

Herhangi bir çözüm bilen var mi?

title: Quitting before start complete kills tabs.
creator: jsallen
content: If Thunderbird startup is stopped before tabs are loaded, they are lost. The tab fields at the top of the screen remain but they are empty. Evidently, tabs are stored only in a temporary location. This is a very annoying bug. Is there a way to recover them?
